sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An evergreen fir endemic to Yuanbao Shan in Guangxi, southern China, where scattered groups grow in cool, wet mixed forest. It can reach 25 m tall, with a trunk about 60 cm in diameter. Its short cylindrical cones are about 8–9 cm long; the leaves have two pale bands underneath.

sections.title: Conservation and uses
sections.text: The species is Critically Endangered and has a very restricted range. Food use, toxicity and other human uses were not verified.
